DNS::rrtype
Description
Returns the resource record type requested by the client.
Note: This command functions only in the context of GTM iRules and
requires the DNS Profile, which is only enabled as part of GTM or the
DNS Services add-on.
Syntax
[
DNS
::
rrtype
]
[
DNS::rrtype
]
Returns the resource record type requested by the client. (e.g. ‘A’,
‘PTR’, ‘MX’)
Examples
Checks the source IP address of each new DNS request, and if
10.10.10.0, uses pool GTM_pool1. If not, the request is checked to
make sure the resource record type is A (address) and the name is
www.domain.com, and if so, cnames the request to
www.redirect.domain.com:
when
DNS_REQUEST
{
if
{
[
IP
::
addr
[
IP
::
client_addr
]
equals
10.10
.10.0
/
24
]
}
{
pool
GTM_pool1
}
elseif
{
([
DNS
::
rrtype
]
eq
"A"
)
and
([
DNS
::
rrname
]
eq
"www.domain.com"
)
}
{
cname
www.redirect.domain.com
}
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
DNS_REQUEST
,
DNS_RESPONSE
,
GLOBAL_GTM
